title: Add J2Model wrapper class

implementation_steps: Read existing j2_power_law.py — note J2PowerLawMaterial, radial_return, ReturnMappingResult
Add J2Model class at bottom of file, inheriting from ConstitutiveModel
pk2_stress(E, alpha=0.0) calls radial_return(self._mat, E, alpha).stress
material_tangent(E, alpha=0.0) calls radial_return(self._mat, E, alpha).tangent
voigt_tangent(E, alpha=0.0) converts tangent to Voigt via tangent_to_voigt_66
Verify all existing standalone functions are unchanged
acceptance_criteria: J2Model wraps radial_return, producing identical numerical output
All existing j2_power_law.py standalone functions untouched
